data.camera: cowboy shot, practicing sword drills on the training ground
data.description: 【艾莉丝 · 挥剑千次】落日将训练场的木桩染成金色，艾莉丝挥剑的剪影一次比一次果断，汗珠顺着下颚滑落，深红发丝贴在颊边——「今天的千次，还差一百。」
data.promptProse: Eris repeats sword drills on the dirt training ground, blade following a deliberate arc as sweat lifts from her brow and ruby eyes remain fiercely concentrated. Headband, crop top and Sword King trousers retain her selected attire. The cowboy view includes the sword motion and ground markings receding behind. Sunset backlight outlines crimson curls, blade and moving fabric, while the raised weapon casts a long narrow shadow across the practice earth.
data.title: 艾莉丝 · 挥剑千次
